question: Which of the following books was written by Megasthenes?
solution:
__
 
• **Indica**__ as written by Megasthenes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Megasthenese wrote extensively in a book called Indica.
 
• The fragments of Indica, provide valuable information on Maurya Administration, social classes and economic activities.
 
• Megasthenes states that Indian society was divided into 7 classes.
 
• The famous city of Pataliputra was described in detail by Megasthenese, references of which are found in the writings of *Strabo, Arian* and other Greek writers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Megasthenes was an ancient Greek historian, diplomat, and Indian ethnographer who visited India sometime between circa 302 BCE and 288 BCE.
 
• He was an ambassador of Seleucus Nicator I, in the court of Chandragupta Maurya.
